notes.title: FARHOME missions are available in SpaceOps VR content update
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1045110/announcements/detail/1631921413943240188]Deatailed information here:[/url]

We added Farhome missions to SpaceOps VR - both old ones and completely new. 
All available for coop play.

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/a17249b4a201415595e9f31fecdcb823c35175c6.jpg[/img]
 
Hi, friends!
We are happy to introduce the first update! 

Its main feature is the ability to change controls:
- Locomotion Swap is added. Now you can swap Move and Turn for controllers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/bb8b76648239247088ffdf89c210b4a975beb9a2.jpg[/img]

- Move and Turn parameters can be fine tuned now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/c9e7e44f5f5b2d75ad89c7b16bf8b70174fe4977.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/3f6e7c38f1b27ac1551abe55727997835c194109.jpg[/img]

We tried to take into account all your suggestions and not to ruin existing game mechanism as well. We plan to release a game guide on controls soon in which we’ll tell you about all the features. 

Subtitles’ transparency and position adjustments are also available now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/558e4ede28f9c33e08819b4077f04f6b78f44add.jpg[/img]

We are waiting for your comments on our discord channel [url=https://discord.gg/phUS8ze] DISCORD [/url]   and in community discussions.

notes.title: FARHOME Release date
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/da1f67179b0a7eb9d79395614fce0a48f5d2341a.jpg[/img]

It's been a long road since we've started the development of such an ambitious project. And finally we're ready to show [b]FARHOME[/b] to you. 

We are extremely proud to announce that [url=store.steampowered.com/app/787550/FARHOME/]FARHOME[/url] will be released in Early Access on April 5 for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive. 

You would be able to play as a members of an elite special purpose squad accompanying a large space mission. The goal of the expedition is to deploy the base, to get the extraction of the most precious cyrium up and running, and also to get ready for launching the Portal that will allow to relocate people to a new place. But the new world holds its own threats and challenges. 

We would like to hear what do you think about FARHOME and answer all your questions regarding the game. 

Prepare yourself for the journey and see you next week!
